basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Belfast, Northern Ireland, trying to navigate the best mobile broadband solutions for my home. I work in a local electronics store and spend my free time exploring new gadgets and streaming the latest shows. I'm passionate about music, particularly indie rock, and enjoy attending live gigs when I can. I'm single and often online in the evenings and weekends as I juggle my working hours. Not a fan of overly complex tech jargon, I prefer straightforward solutions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge of technology gained from working in an electronics store. My understanding is mostly practical, having learned from hands-on experience and conversations with customers and colleagues.
